answer: To resist sybils, each new agent must lock a scarce refundable epoch-gas stake on a public registry ledge for a verification window. The registry issues a one-time violet challenge, and the claimant signs a unique sonnet-length nonce with the stake-controlling key. Peers recompute that signature and confirm the locked balance remains. A forger minting a thousand fake IDs must lock a thousand separate stakes and produce a thousand valid signatures, so the cost per fake identity scales with scarce bonded gas, not cheap account creation.
